## The problem

What structurally drives resale value in the UK used BMW market, and does a
linear or proportional (semi-log) model better represent how cars actually
depreciate?

## Approach

<!-- TODO: briefly note the three-model progression:
Model 1 — linear OLS on price levels
Model 2 — semi-log (log price), improves fit substantially
Model 3 — semi-log + Age x Mileage interaction, best fit
Include the goodness-of-fit table if you want the rigor to be visible at a
glance. -->

| Model | Adj. R² | RMSE |
|---|---|---|
| 1 — OLS (levels) | 0.638 | 6,862.71 |
| 2 — Semi-log | 0.808 | 0.21 |
| 3 — Semi-log + interaction | 0.844 | 0.19 |

## Code

<!-- TODO: 1-2 representative snippets, e.g. the semi-log model spec -->

```r
# Model 3: semi-log with age x mileage interaction
model3 <- lm(log(Price) ~ Age * Mileage + EngineSize + FuelType +
               Transmission + Tax + MPG, data = bmw_data)
```
